82560094cdcf6779.description: Description PetroApp runs fuel payments and fleet control for businesses across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Nigeria, and Thailand. Drivers pay with NFC at partner stations, fleet managers set limits and see every transaction in real time, and our fraud checks stop bad transactions before they go through. We are now building beyond fuel, with vehicle services, a consumer app for car owners, and more tools for the stations we work with. As a Product Manager, you will own problems end to end, from finding them with users to measuring what changed after release. Most of what we ship touches real payments at real stations, so quality matters as much as speed. Your product area will be set based on your strengths and where the company needs you most. Roles : · Own a problem area end to end: discovery, definition, delivery, and results after launch · Talk to the people who use PetroApp every day: fleet managers, finance teams, drivers, station staff, and car owners. Go to stations and customer sites when that is where the answer is · Turn what you learn into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guessing · Work with Engineering, Design, Operations, Customer Support, Sales, and Marketing to ship on time and at quality · Prioritize your backlog by user and business impact, and be ready to explain every trade-off · Run sprint planning and refinement with your team, and clear blockers before they slow delivery · Set success metrics before you build and track them after launch. Pull your own numbers when you need them · Plan for the real-world edge cases: failed payments, offline stations, fraud attempts, regulatory rules, and differences between countries · Keep track of competitors and bring back what matters Roles and Responsibilities · Own a problem area end to end: discovery, definition, delivery, and results after launch · Talk to the people who use PetroApp every day: fleet managers, finance teams, drivers, station staff, and car owners. Go to stations and customer sites when that is where the answer is · Turn what you learn into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guessing · Work with Engineering, Design, Operations, Customer Support, Sales, and Marketing to ship on time and at quality · Prioritize your backlog by user and business impact, and be ready to explain every trade-off · Run sprint planning and refinement with your team, and clear blockers before they slow delivery · Set success metrics before you build and track them after launch. Pull your own numbers when you need them · Plan for the real-world edge cases: failed payments, offline stations, fraud attempts, regulatory rules, and differences between countries · Keep track of competitors and bring back what matters · 1 to 3 years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, mobility, logistics, or B2B SaaS · Shipped at least one mobile or web product or feature you can walk us through, including what did not work · Comfortable with data: you can define a metric, read a dashboard, and question it. SQL is a plus · Clear writer. Your specs, tickets, and updates are short and hard to misread · Experience working in agile teams (Scrum or Kanban) · Good grasp of UX basics and used to working closely with designers · Able to build for very different users, from finance managers at a desk to drivers and station staff on the forecourt · Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field · Real ownership of problems that change how businesses and drivers pay for fuel and run their vehicles · Work across payments, NFC-based transactions, fraud prevention, and data in one company · A fast, practical team where shipping and learning beat long debates · Direct access to product leadership and a clear path to a senior role · Impact you can measure: money saved, fraud stopped, and hours given back to fleet teams

82c0c49e15755c46.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التواصل الشامل المتحدة عن معلم صعوبات التعلم للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم التعليمي المتخصص للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة، ومساعدتهم على تحقيق إمكاناتهم التعليمية الكاملة من خلال توفير التعليمات والأدوات والمواد اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس التي تتناسب مع الأهداف التعليمية المحددة، واختيار المصادر، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس، بالإضافة إلى طرق التدريس والمحتوى المناسب. تدريس الطلاب، سواء بشكل فردي أو في مجموعات صغيرة، كيفية استخدام التقنيات المتخصصة لتلبية احتياجاتهم التعليمية، وتنظيم الدروس والواجبات والأنشطة العملية. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الكفاءة التعليمية والتعامل مع الاحتياجات الخاصة، والتواصل مع مقدمي الخدمات التعليمية والطبية لتحديد الخطط والأولويات الإنمائية. التعاون مع المدرسين والباحثين لتطوير طرق جديدة لإرشاد ودعم الأطفال من ذوي الإعاقة. تثقيف المجتمع حول احتياجات الأطفال ذوي الإعاقة وكيفية تلبيتها في الحياة اليومية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال تدريس صعوبات التعلم أو التعليم الخاص. القدرة على تقديم الدعم الفني والتعليمي للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم. بيئة العمل يعمل معلم صعوبات التعلم في بيئة داعمة في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أفضل النتائج التعليمية للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. ملخص الدور يتولى معلم صعوبات التعلم مسؤولية تقديم الدعم التعليمي المتخصص للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة، وتطوير خطط تعليمية فردية، وتقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم، والتعاون مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحقيق أقصى استفادة تعليمية. هذا الدور يتطلب خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات.

8254c8e8e3aeb5cc.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking an experienced Head of Product, Agile Delivery & Transformation to lead a large-scale digital transformation program for a prominent organization in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Jeddah or Makkah and requires a leader capable of driving end-to-end transformation planning, establishing Agile squads, and overseeing product delivery to align business strategy with technology and execution. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning and execution of large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Develop and manage integrated transformation roadmaps across Business, Data, AI, Cloud Migration, Experience Design, and Software Development. Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Manage cross-functional dependencies, risks, and critical program decisions. Establish and manage cross-functional Agile squad operating models. Drive product strategy, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, and release management. Oversee the complete product lifecycle, from discovery and design to development, deployment, and continuous improvement. Ensure alignment between Product, Engineering, UX/UI, QA, and Business teams. Promote outcome-driven Agile practices and predictable delivery. Establish and lead high-performing cross-functional squads and dedicated SWAT teams for critical initiatives. Define squad responsibilities, delivery processes, governance structures, and performance measures. Resolve delivery bottlenecks and improve collaboration across workstreams. Establish transformation governance frameworks, reporting structures, and accountability models. Define milestone-based SLAs, delivery expectations, and escalation procedures. Monitor program progress, delivery performance, risks, and dependencies. Provide executive-level reporting on transformation progress, milestones, and business outcomes. Collaborate with senior business and technology leadership to align transformation priorities. Drive organizational adoption of Agile methodologies and modern product delivery practices. Facilitate strategic decision-making and resolve cross-functional challenges. Build a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a strategic yet hands-on transformation leader capable of translating business vision into structured execution. This role requires a combination of strong product thinking, enterprise-level Agile delivery, technical understanding, and executive stakeholder management to drive measurable business and customer outcomes. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in enterprise digital transformation, product strategy, Agile delivery, program governance, and technology modernization. Demonstrated leadership experience in large-scale digital transformation programs. Proficiency in establishing and managing cross-functional Agile operating models. Experience in driving product strategy, roadmap development, and backlog prioritization. Ability to establish transformation governance frameworks and accountability models. Strong stakeholder management and change management capabilities. Work Location This position is a full-time role located in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Jeddah.

8276bd6f643b2a5e.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the world forward. The company's vehicles are built on proprietary technology and a software-defined architecture, reflecting a "Compromise Nothing™" approach in the global automotive market. This involves integrating performance with sustainability, and design with engineering. Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity models are designed to redefine their segments by combining range, performance, design, and spaciousness. This is achieved through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production managed in-house across global offices and manufacturing facilities. The Role: Quality Electrical Engineer (VRE) Powertrain Lucid Motors Middle East is seeking a Quality Electrical Engineer (VRE) Powertrain to join its team in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for electrical and electronic Powertrain Quality engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle and manufacturing launch. The engineer ensures that electrical components, high-voltage interfaces, control systems, assembly processes, and end-of-line tests meet engineering specifications, Lucid Quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations. The role involves collaboration with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Incoming Quality, Launch, Maintenance, Test Engineering, and Production teams to prevent defects and drive corrective actions. Key Responsibilities Manage Quality engineering activities for electrical and electronic Powertrain components and assembly processes, including electric motors, inverters, power electronics, wiring, connectors, sensors, control modules, and high-voltage interfaces. Ensure compliance of Quality deliverables at each launch milestone and confirm electrical product, software, test, and process readiness before production and volume ramp-up. Review electrical schematics, specifications, interface requirements, special characteristics, DFMEA/PFMEA, control plans, work instructions, and test standards for completeness and manufacturing applicability. Coordinate APQP/PPAP and validation of electrical parts and processes, including continuity, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, grounding, connector engagement, pin integrity, torque, end-of-line functional tests, and diagnostic checks. Define incoming, in-process, control point, and end-of-line inspection and test requirements, and support test equipment qualification, measurement system analysis, calibration, golden samples, limits, and operator training. Monitor production Quality performance and lead containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and effectiveness verification for electrical, electronic, diagnostic, and high-voltage defects. Lead cross-functional problem-solving for intermittent faults, connector and harness issues, sensor signals, communication faults, insulation failures, test escapes, and workmanship concerns affecting Powertrain Quality and Field Quality. Support equipment qualification, process validation, line trials, safe launch, layered process audits, and readiness reviews for new or changed electrical assembly and test processes. Partner with Supplier Quality to address electrical component nonconformities, verify corrective actions, and improve capability and parts maturity. Manage nonconforming product disposition with cross-functional teams and ensure traceability, segregation, repair validation, software or calibration control, and protection of internal and external customers. Analyze test, diagnostic, repair, audit, warranty, and field data to identify trends and implement preventive improvements. Support engineering and software change implementation by confirming validation, configuration control, documentation, training, parts readiness, and Quality approvals before production release. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 2-5 years of experience in Powertrain, automotive manufacturing, testing, or product engineering within an automotive OEM or Tier 1 environment. Experience with electrical schematics, diagnostic tools, measurement systems, MSA, SPC, capability analysis, and automotive core tools. Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support production priorities, and communicate technical issues effectively across different organizational levels. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Practical experience with EV Powertrain electrical systems, electric motors, inverters, power electronics, high-voltage components, harnesses, sensors, controllers, or end-of-line testing. Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, or high-volume production ramp-up. High-voltage training or certification and familiarity with functional safety, configuration control, and vehicle network diagnostics. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with diverse teams across global offices and manufacturing facilities, contributing to the development and production of advanced electric vehicles.

82404b8fd0bf27f3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح مختلف أنواع معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن فريق شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجميع سياسات وإجراءات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيعتمد على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

Role Overview The Key Account Manager will be responsible for managing a portfolio of high-value, structured accounts, each generating at least SAR 8 million in annual revenue. This role involves building strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within these accounts and positioning Sitaf Food as a preferred partner in their menu development cycles, procurement processes, and long-term business plans. Anticipate menu changes and product requirements, developing tailored solutions to position Sitaf Food as the preferred supply partner. Lead senior-level customer meetings and monthly business reviews, coordinating with the Sales Leadership Team on account performance, opportunities, and action plans. Introduce new products and drive their adoption into customers’ regular purchasing portfolios. Develop and execute strategic account plans with a one- to two-year horizon. Collaborate closely with Field Sales Representatives to ensure consistent execution and service across customer locations. Gather, maintain, and regularly update account and stakeholder information in the customer master database. Prepare and maintain rolling forecasts by account and item, coordinating with internal teams to support product availability and demand planning. Take ownership of receivables follow-up, working closely with customers and Finance to ensure timely collection. 82d364ea84810d5a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الريان الخاصه للبنات الأهلية عن معلم للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص، وتقديم الدعم لتنميتهم الأكاديمية والشخصية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد، مع التركيز على تقديم تعليم فعال. وضع خطط الدروس التي تتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. تقديم التعليمات للطلاب بشكل فردي وجماعي، بما يلبي احتياجات التعلم المتنوعة. اختيار المصادر التعليمية المناسبة وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تطوير طرق التدريس والمحتوى لضمان تجربة تعليمية شاملة ومحفزة. دعم التنمية الشاملة للطلاب، بما في ذلك الجوانب الأكاديمية والاجتماعية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التدريس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع خطط دروس فعالة وتصميم مواد تعليمية مبتكرة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على التفاعل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، وتوفر بيئة تعليمية داعمة تهدف إلى تعزيز النمو الأكاديمي للطلاب. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. معلومات إضافية تلتزم مدارس الريان الخاصه للبنات الأهلية بتقديم تعليم عالي الجودة وتطوير قدرات الطلاب. هذا الدور يمثل فرصة للمساهمة في بيئة تعليمية محفزة وداعمة.

82f9995ad755cbb1.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة الخليج المعدنية للتعدين عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج في الجهة، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. الهدف من الدور يهدف هذا الدور إلى متابعة عمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج، ومراقبة سير العمل فيها، ووضع وتتبع موازناتها وإجراءاتها التعاقدية. كما يشمل تحديد تكاليفها ومصادر تمويلها، ومتابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجازها وتحقيقها للأهداف الموضوعة بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنة المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط، المتابعة، وإدارة الموارد. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة الاستراتيجية من خلال إدارة مشاريع فعالة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق الخليج المعدنية للتعدين.

8204fd21d780e772.description: About Jazeera Paints Jazeera Paints is seeking a Call Center Agent to join their team in Khamis Mushayt. Record and update customer databases with communication details. Review and effectively address all incoming emails to the Customer Care Department. 8218fe9090bef75e.description: نبحث عن مساعد إداري من ذوي الهمم متحمس ومنظم للانضمام إلى فريقنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية، بما في ذلك جدولة المواعيد، وإدارة المراسلات، وتنظيم الملفات. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وقدرة على العمل تحت الضغط، وتبحث عن بيئة عمل داعمة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. تشمل المهام الرئيسية: * تنظيم وإدارة المواعيد والاجتماعات. * التعامل مع المراسلات الواردة والصادرة (بريد إلكتروني، فواتير، تقارير). * الحفاظ على نظام ملفات دقيق ومنظم. * تقديم الدعم الإداري للفريق عند الحاجة. * استقبال الزوار والرد على الاستفسارات الهاتفية.

82c0e724d6c6e9f8.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking an Operating Room Nurse 3 to join their team in Dhahran or Al-Ahsa. This full-time position involves providing comprehensive, evidence-based professional nursing care to patients within the Operating Room (OR) facilities. The role requires adherence to organizational and departmental policies and procedures, with work performed across various shifts, including on-call duties and scheduled overtime, to meet operational needs. Key Responsibilities Contribute to strategic initiatives aimed at improving nursing practices within assigned units. Participate in the development of protocols and processes to enhance patient safety and operational efficiency. Deliver high-quality nursing care services, with a focus on complex cases. Assist in managing workflow, ensuring proper resource utilization, and providing mentorship to junior nurses. Ensure adherence to clinical protocols and participate in the evaluation of patient outcomes. Achieve and/or maintain the mandated activities for level 3, requiring a minimum of 20 points across at least four categories within each 12-month cycle, as outlined in the Clinical Advancement Program. Utilize the nursing process to assess, plan, implement, evaluate, and document patient care from admission through discharge, specific to the patient's age. Provide nursing care and patient/family education consistent with the plan of care and patient needs, respecting privacy, dignity, personal preference, and culture. Precept new hires and trainees during their probation training period and provide recommendations regarding progress and training needs. Respond promptly and effectively to emergency and life-saving situations using clinical skills, critical thinking, and evidence-based practices. Perform a wide range of nursing procedures with attention to accuracy, patient safety, and comfort, while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized environment. Represent the unit or department on committees, special interest groups, and task forces as assigned. Complete specific competencies identified by the manager/clinical nurse educator according to the scope of service of the assigned area. Operating Room Specific Competencies Ensure safe procedures in accordance with international patient safety goals and JHAH policies. Act as a scrub or circulating nurse based on the OR schedule. Set up the operating room according to the type of operation and Association of Perioperative Registered Nurses (AORN) recommendations. Assist the surgeon during complex operative, diagnostic, and therapeutic procedures within the scope of service. Ensure all pre, intra, and post-op documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner. Demonstrate familiarity with specialized OR equipment and manage equipment malfunctions during surgery. Evaluate supplies and equipment for patient care and provide input to the service team leader/OR Manager. Observe and maintain strict aseptic practices. Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) Specific Competencies Monitor patients in the PACU in accordance with American Society of Perianesthesia Nurses (ASPAN) and JHAH standards. Ensure all post-anesthesia documentation is completed promptly and in the relevant format. Administer medications intravenously or by patient-controlled analgesia as per clinician's order and JHAH standards. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in an operating room setting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in either Al-Ahsa or Dhahran, within the Operating Room facilities of Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare. The role requires flexibility to work various shifts, including on-call and scheduled overtime, to meet operational demands.

82ebe8db1f3a4b81.description: About DXC Technology DXC Technology is a global enterprise technology and innovation partner, providing software, services, and solutions to organizations worldwide. The company specializes in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, focusing on modernizing, securing, and operating complex technology estates. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on establishing an integrated, closed-loop operating model that connects Dynatrace observability and Davis AI with ServiceNow ITSM for intelligent event correlation, incident management, orchestration, and automated remediation across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments. Key Responsibilities Define and govern ServiceNow platform architecture, including ITSM, CMDB, CSDM, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub. Design end-to-end integration between Dynatrace and ServiceNow for event management, incident creation, and automated remediation. Lead enterprise observability strategy using Dynatrace SaaS across infrastructure, applications, and networks. Implement AIOps capabilities, Davis AI-driven event correlation, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis. Establish telemetry collection, enrichment, routing, retention, sampling, and cost optimization standards. Align CMDB/CSDM with monitored services to enable effective event correlation and service visibility. Define SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and proactive alerting strategies. Establish automation governance, testing, rollback, audit, and change-management controls. Provide architecture leadership, conduct design reviews, and engage with technical teams and business stakeholders. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline. 7+ years of relevant technology experience, including 3+ years in architecture or technical leadership. Proven experience delivering enterprise ServiceNow and observability solutions. Strong architectural governance, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. Required Technical Skills Strong expertise in ServiceNow architecture, ITSM, CMDB, CSDM, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and Glide APIs. Hands-on architecture experience with Dynatrace SaaS, Davis AI, APM, infrastructure monitoring, and event management. Proficiency with REST/SOAP APIs and enterprise integration patterns. Experience with enterprise observability covering metrics, logs, traces, and events. Knowledge of AIOps, event correlation, closed-loop automation, and auto-remediation. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, service mesh, and cloud-native observability. At least one ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS). Preferred: ServiceNow CAD, CTA, or CMA. Dynatrace Associate or Professional Certification. ITIL 4 Foundation or TOGAF.

82102207700dbd48.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة زرقاء اليمامة للتطوير العقاري عن مشرف عمليات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على سير العمليات اليومية ومتابعة تنفيذ الخطط التشغيلية للمشاريع العقارية، مع ضمان كفاءة استخدام الموارد والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية ومعايير الجودة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف مشرف العمليات إلى تحسين الأداء التشغيلي ورفع مستوى الإنتاجية، بما يسهم في تحقيق أهداف الشركة وتعزيز نجاح مشاريعها العقارية وفق أعلى معايير الكفاءة والتميز. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على العمليات اليومية ومتابعة تنفيذ الخطط التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. تنظيم وتوزيع المهام التشغيلية على الفرق المعنية ومتابعة مستوى الإنجاز وفق الأولويات والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة. التنسيق بين الإدارات المختلفة، بما في ذلك الهندسة والمبيعات والمالية والمشتريات، لضمان تكامل الأعمال وتحقيق متطلبات المشاريع العقارية. متابعة سير العمل في المشاريع العقارية ورصد التحديات والمعوقات التشغيلية والعمل على معالجتها بالتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة. مراقبة كفاءة استخدام الموارد البشرية والمادية والتشغيلية، والمساهمة في تحسين الإنتاجية وترشيد التكاليف. متابعة أداء الموظفين والفرق التشغيلية والتأكد من الالتزام بالإجراءات والسياسات ومعايير الجودة المعتمدة. التنسيق مع الموردين والمقاولين ومتابعة الالتزامات التشغيلية ومواعيد التوريد والتنفيذ وفق الخطط المعتمدة. إعداد وتطوير التقارير التشغيلية الدورية التي توضح مستوى الإنجاز ومؤشرات الأداء والتحديات والتوصيات التحسينية. المساهمة في تطوير الإجراءات والسياسات التشغيلية وتبسيط سير العمل لدعم التوسع في المشاريع العقارية ورفع مستوى الأداء المؤسسي. متابعة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والميزانيات التشغيلية المعتمدة، ورفع الملاحظات المتعلقة بالتأخير أو الانحرافات للإدارة المختصة. التنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية لضمان معالجة الملاحظات التشغيلية وتنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية وتحقيق التحسين المستمر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال العمليات أو التطوير العقاري. القدرة على الإشراف على العمليات اليومية وتنسيق المهام بفعالية. فهم جيد للخطط التشغيلية ومعايير الجودة في المشاريع العقارية. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف العمليات ضمن فريق مؤسسة زرقاء اليمامة للتطوير العقاري في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع مختلف الإدارات والفرق لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

821e67ebf09a8bd1.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Officer-Loss Prevention to join their team in Medina. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of guests, employees, and property assets. The role involves patrolling all areas, monitoring security systems, and responding to various incidents to maintain an orderly and secure environment. Key Responsibilities Patrol all property areas and assist guests with room access as needed. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions (CCTV), perimeter alarm systems, duress alarms, and fire life safety systems. Lock property entrances when required and conduct daily physical hazard inspections. Respond to accidents, administer first aid/CPR if necessary, and contact emergency medical services (EMS). Assist guests and employees during emergency situations and notify appropriate individuals of incidents. Defuse guest and employee disturbances, calling for outside assistance when necessary. Complete incident reports to document all security and loss prevention related occurrences. Resolve safety hazard situations and escort unwelcome persons from the property without disrupting operations. Respond to scenes of vehicle accidents/thefts and call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all security/loss prevention and property reports/documents, releasing information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations, gather evidence, and interview relevant parties. Follow all company policies and procedures, report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions, and complete required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate clearly and professionally, and prepare and review written documents accurately. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, support team goals, and comply with quality assurance expectations. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 year of relevant experience is required. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Ability to move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces, and over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats (*, small print) and visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Competency in entering and locating work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements for this position. The team emphasizes engaging experiences and thoughtful service, inviting individuals to contribute to a supportive and collaborative environment. Application Process Candidates who are team players and committed to delivering meaningful guest experiences are encouraged to explore this career opportunity with Sheraton Hotels & Resorts, a brand within the Marriott International portfolio.

823167a655c57ff6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية من المريض وذويه لدراسة الحالة المرضية بشكل شامل. إجراء الفحص السريري وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية. تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ضمن موضوع التخصص. وضع خطط علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها وفقاً للمعايير المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص. شهادة جامعية في الطب مع تخصص ذي صلة. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية في ممارسة الطب. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مدينة الخفجي بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويوفر بيئة عمل احترافية ضمن فريق صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

826f96fafc7137d6.description: ملخص الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على الأنشطة اليومية لفريق المبيعات وتوجيهها، لضمان تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية وأهداف الشركة. ويشمل ذلك تدريب مندوبي المبيعات وتحفيزهم ومتابعة أدائهم، إلى جانب دعمهم في استقطاب العملاء المحتملين، وإدارة علاقات العملاء، وإتمام الصفقات البيعية. كما يتعاون مشرف المبيعات مع الإدارة لتطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات، ومتابعة أداء الفريق، والحفاظ على مستويات عالية من جودة خدمة العملاء. وتتطلب هذه الوظيفة مهارات قيادية وتواصلية قوية، والقدرة على حل المشكلات وتحقيق النتائج في بيئة عمل سريعة التغير وشديدة التنافسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الإشراف على فريق المبيعات وتدريبه وتحفيزه لضمان تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية الفردية والجماعية أو تجاوزها. توزيع العملاء المحتملين (Leads) على أعضاء الفريق، ومتابعة إجراءات التواصل معهم، وضمان إدارة ومتابعة الفرص البيعية بشكل فعّال. عقد اجتماعات دورية مع فريق المبيعات لمراجعة الأداء، ومشاركة المستجدات، ومناقشة التحديات والعمل على معالجتها. دعم مندوبي المبيعات في تقديم الاستشارات للعملاء، وعرض العقارات والمشاريع، وإتمام الصفقات البيعية عند الحاجة. متابعة وتحليل مؤشرات أداء فريق المبيعات، وإعداد التقارير البيعية، وتقديم التوصيات والملاحظات العملية للإدارة. ضمان الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والأنظمة واللوائح العقارية، ومعايير التوثيق وحفظ المستندات. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية والعمل على تطوير مهارات وقدرات فريق المبيعات. المساهمة في إعداد وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات والعروض الترويجية والحملات التسويقية بما يسهم في زيادة الإيرادات. المحافظة على مستويات عالية من رضا العملاء من خلال ضمان سرعة الاستجابة، وتقديم خدمة احترافية، ومعالجة استفسارات العملاء وملاحظاتهم. التنسيق مع إدارات التسويق والمالية والعمليات لتحسين إجراءات وعمليات البيع ورفع كفاءتها التشغيلية. تمثيل الشركة في الفعاليات والمعارض والاجتماعات مع العملاء، بمشاركة أعضاء الفريق عند الحاجة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات دبلوم أو درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال، أو العلاقات العامة، أو التسويق، أو أي تخصص ذي صلة، مع توفر خبرة عملية مثبتة في مجال المبيعات العقارية. أيام وساعات العمل أيام العمل: 6 أيام في الأسبوع. ساعات العمل: 8 ساعات يوميًا.

821154d86f916b0c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة توارد عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية، وتنظيم أعمال البريد والمواعيد اليومية، وإنجاز الأعمال الإدارية المتعلقة بسير العمل، بالإضافة إلى تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى فتح البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفق توجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية. تنظيم وحفظ الملفات والمعاملات بأسلوب يسهل الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها. طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات والتعليمات الإدارية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة في إدارة البريد والمواعيد. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية فعالة. القدرة على إنجاز مهام الطباعة والتعامل مع الاستفسارات الهاتفية. مهارات تنظيم الملفات والوثائق بكفاءة. الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في تدوين وتوثيق محاضر الاجتماعات. بيئة العمل سيعمل المساعد الإداري بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة توارد في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الرئيس المباشر وموظفي الوحدة التنظيمية لضمان سير العمل الإداري بسلاسة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

8214f74d7ed37608.description: About the Role Alfanar Projects is seeking an experienced SR.ENGINEER, PROJECT to lead engineering, coordination, execution, testing, and commissioning activities for EHV/HV Substation Projects (110kV–380kV) in Riyadh. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves managing the complete engineering lifecycle from design development to project closeout and handover. Key Responsibilities Lead engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle, from design to closeout. Manage engineering schedules, deliverables, approvals, and interfaces to support project milestones. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, OEMs, vendors, and internal teams. Ensure compliance with SEC, National Grid, IEC standards, and project specifications. Support planning, procurement, construction, cost control, risk management, and reporting. Maintain submittal registers and approval workflows for drawings, technical submittals, vendor documents, material approvals, ITPs, and method statements. Track client comments and ensure timely resolution to prevent construction delays. Identify and manage design dependencies and multidisciplinary interfaces across electrical, protection & control, civil, mechanical, telecom, and SCADA systems. Lead coordination meetings, resolve design clashes, and ensure consistency across engineering disciplines. Review and coordinate mechanical systems including transformers, reactors, HVAC, firefighting, diesel generators, fuel, and plumbing systems. Manage review and approval of architectural drawings and building layouts, ensuring compliance with client, regulatory, security, and operational requirements. Manage technical interfaces among clients, consultants, OEMs, contractors, and National Grid/SEC representatives. Coordinate vendor documentation, FAT activities, technical clarifications, and issue resolution. Maintain interface registers and action trackers. Prepare commissioning readiness plans and ensure completion of QA/QC documentation, approved drawings, protection settings, vendor support, and punch-list closure. Coordinate FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and energization activities for GIS/AIS equipment, transformers, reactors, protection, SCADA, telecom, and MV/LV systems. Support system integration, operational handover, PAC/FAC requirements, as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training records, and final project closeout. Role Accountabilities Train subordinates and build an effective team. Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to subordinates. Delegate assignments and ensure fair task distribution to maintain morale and motivation. Execute planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Resolve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met by developing effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project engineering, specifically with EHV/HV Substation Projects (110kV–380kV). Strong experience with SEC/National Grid substation projects. Proven experience in engineering management and stakeholder coordination. Demonstrated ability to deliver high-voltage substations within schedule, quality, and contractual requirements. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a strong commitment to managing complex substation projects.

828777de6a35adef.description: About the Role MediServ is seeking a Legal Specialist to join its Legal Department in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role supports the company's commercial and legal activities within the medical devices and healthcare industry. The ideal candidate will possess 1-4 years of experience and a strong understanding of Saudi laws and regulations, particularly concerning commercial contracts, legal advisory, regulatory compliance, and contract management. Key Responsibilities Draft, review, amend, and negotiate commercial agreements, including distribution, supply, sales, service, and consultancy contracts. Provide day-to-day legal advice and support to internal departments. Coordinate with Regulatory Affairs and Quality teams on applicable Saudi laws and regulations, including SFDA requirements. Prepare and review legal correspondence, corporate documents, authorizations, and resolutions. Assist in managing contractual disputes, claims, breach notices, and settlement documentation. Maintain contract records and monitor contractual obligations and deadlines. Conduct legal research, prepare legal memoranda, and identify potential legal risks. Qualifications and Experience 1-4 years of experience in a legal role. Demonstrated experience in commercial contracts, legal advisory, regulatory compliance, and contract management. Strong understanding of Saudi laws and regulations. Preferred Background Background in medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, distribution, or other regulated industries. Familiarity with Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) regulatory requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within MediServ's Legal Department. The role involves collaboration with various internal departments, including Regulatory Affairs and Quality teams.

82c3e73f10533737.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري لقسم الصيانة، مع التركيز على إدارة المخزون، وأوامر العمل، والسجلات، والمشتريات، والتقارير. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في ضمان استمرارية التشغيل وكفاءة التكلفة ودقة البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديث سجلات أوامر الصيانة، وقطع الغيار، والأدوات، والمعدات بشكل دوري. استلام وفحص وتسجيل مواد الصيانة الواردة، ومعالجة أي فروقات قد تظهر. متابعة مستويات المخزون بشكل مستمر وبدء عملية إعادة الطلب عند الوصول إلى الحد المحدد. إعداد طلبات وأوامر الشراء اللازمة وحفظ مستندات الموردين بدقة. تتبع عمليات الصرف والإرجاع، وتسوية الفروقات، وإجراء الجرد الدوري للمخزون. معالجة وإغلاق أوامر العمل ضمن نظام إدارة الصيانة المعتمد. إدخال البيانات، وأرشفة المستندات، وإعداد التقارير، وتقديم الدعم المكتبي العام. تنظيم المستودع أو ورشة الصيانة لضمان بيئة عمل فعالة ومنظمة. تنسيق قطع الغيار، والمواعيد، والوثائق مع الفنيين والإدارات المعنية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بالصيانة الميكانيكية أو الدعم الإداري للصيانة. القدرة على إدارة المخزون وتتبع السجلات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في استخدام أنظمة إدارة الصيانة (CMMS) إن وجدت. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات وإعداد التقارير. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعاون مع الفنيين والإدارات المختلفة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق الصيانة في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

82e737ea2bdcf2fb.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Manager - Outreach Engagement to lead the team responsible for member outreach, education, enrollment, and ongoing engagement in CareConnect health programs. This full-time position is based in Jeddah and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on driving consultation bookings and completion, supporting member retention, and ensuring a consistent member experience through effective team management and coordination with clinical and operational teams. Key Responsibilities Lead proactive member outreach to introduce CareConnect services, explain program benefits, and support enrollment in appropriate programs. Identify member needs, goals, and pain points, developing targeted outreach plans aligned with departmental objectives. Allocate team and individual targets, manage workloads, and ensure adequate staffing coverage. Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, and development discussions, addressing training needs and performance gaps. Oversee initial and repeat consultation bookings, monitor completion and no-shows, and manage reminders, cancellations, and rebooking processes. Develop and oversee an efficient, comprehensive onboarding process tailored to member needs, communicating expected timelines to new members. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (*, RCM, Medical team, technical teams) to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and coordinate member follow-up. Monitor and analyze team performance across various metrics including calls, reachability, enrollment, bookings, consultation completion, retention, and quality. Maintain accurate dashboards, provide timely performance reports, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions. Support the implementation of AI-powered engagement tools, identify system enhancement requirements, and coordinate with IT and stakeholders. Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), validate workflows, and coordinate team training and adoption of new systems. Monitor interaction quality, documentation accuracy, and compliance with approved processes and agreed SLAs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant professional experience is required. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team effectively. Experience in member outreach, education, and engagement programs. Proficiency in performance monitoring and reporting. Familiarity with digital enablement tools and system enhancement processes. Team Leadership and Operational Management This role involves significant leadership responsibilities, including setting targets, managing workloads, and ensuring team adherence to approved workflows and service standards. The Manager will be responsible for coaching team members, conducting performance reviews, and identifying development needs to enhance overall team performance. Performance Monitoring and Quality Improvement The Manager will continuously monitor and analyze team performance metrics, maintaining accurate dashboards and providing timely reports to department leadership. This includes identifying performance gaps, implementing corrective actions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives based on member feedback and operational insights. The role also supports the integration of AI-powered engagement tools and system enhancements to improve productivity and member experience. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Jeddah. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

82f6e13804970b46.description: We are seeking a skilled IT Support professional to join our dynamic team and provide essential technical assistance. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess excellent problem-solving abilities, and be dedicated to delivering high-quality user support. Key Responsibilities: * Provide first-level technical support to end-users, addressing hardware, software, and network issues. * Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware, software, systems, networks, printers, and scanners. * Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal functionality and uptime. * Document and track all support requests and resolutions in a timely manner. * Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding and responsible for employee trainings for the applications. * Assist with IT asset management and inventory control. * Collaborate with senior IT staff on larger projects and system upgrades.

827434052cd55bcd.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef
827434052cd55bcd.description: About the Opportunity The Career Nest is partnering with a dining establishment in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, known for its focus on quality food and hospitality. This establishment is seeking a dedicated pastry professional to contribute to its pastry section. The Role of Junior Pastry Sous Chef As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will support the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section. This full-time role involves taking ownership of daily production, maintaining quality standards, and contributing to the development of the junior team. The position requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant pastry role and offers a salary of 7,000 SAR monthly. Core Responsibilities Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision and attention to presentation. Participate in motivating and developing the pastry team, maintaining discipline during busy periods, and leading the section in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Plan daily production, monitor shelf life, maintain strict FIFO and labeling standards, and execute freezing and defrosting procedures. Ensure all items meet strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal, while maintaining a clean, safe, and compliant workspace. Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste to maintain quality while controlling food costs. Required Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a pastry-related role. Demonstrated ability to execute pastry techniques with precision. Experience in managing daily production and maintaining quality standards. Capability to lead a section and mentor junior team members. 82a3ee154a35a519.description: About the Role Wardat Almashreq is seeking a Senior Accountant to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on overseeing accounts payable operations, ensuring accurate and timely processing of supplier transactions, and maintaining strong internal controls. The Senior Accountant will also support month-end closing activities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure compliance with company policies and financial procedures. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily accounts payable activities and ensure all invoices are processed accurately and on time. Review and control the three-way matching process between purchase orders, goods receipts, and supplier invoices. Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies in coordination with Procurement, Warehouse, and other relevant departments. Manage month-end accounts payable closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and clearing outstanding items. Prepare and review vendor payment plans based on due dates, approvals, and cash flow requirements. Review supplier payments to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with approval workflows. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and handle payment-related inquiries and escalations. Perform supplier statement reconciliations and resolve outstanding differences. Review foreign currency transactions and ensure proper accounting treatment of exchange rate differences. Monitor accounts payable aging and identify risks related to overdue balances and vendor exposure. Prepare periodic reports, reconciliations, and analysis for management review. Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and segregation of duties requirements. Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and information. Guide and support junior team members while ensuring continuity of operations during staff absences. Perform any other duties related to the position as assigned by management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a detail-oriented professional capable of managing multiple tasks and collaborating with various departments.

8293a0ea41d3314e.description: Job Title: Food Safety & Quality Specialist Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia Experience: 4 Years Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Food Safety & Quality Specialist to ensure compliance with food safety standards, quality requirements, and regulatory guidelines across our food and beverage operations. Key Responsibilities Monitor food safety and quality standards across operations. Conduct regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with food safety regulations. Ensure proper food handling, storage, preparation, and hygiene practices. Implement and monitor HACCP, GMP, and food safety procedures. Identify non-compliance issues and follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Train employees on food safety, hygiene, and quality standards. Maintain inspection records, quality reports, and food safety documentation. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi food safety regulations and SFDA requirements. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Safety, Microbiology, or a related field. 4 years of relevant experience in food safety and quality, preferably within the restaurant or food and beverage industry. Good knowledge of HACCP, GMP, and food safety management systems. Familiarity with SFDA regulations and food safety requirements in Saudi Arabia. Good English communication and reporting skills. Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and problem-solving abilities. Willingness to work in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

82f8f9879c6d97e2.description: Position Job Title Electrical Technician Job location (Department/Plant) Maintenance Reporting to Electrical Supervisor Job Summary Works under the direction of electrical Supervisor to execute all preventive and corrective maintenance, monthly /annual outage and overhauling work activities on plant equipments Roles & Responsibilities S. No. Responsibility 1 To performs routine, corrective and preventive maintenance of plant equipments as per the direction of Electrical Supervisor. Diagnoses cause of electrical malfunction or failure of operational equipment such as transformers, motors, relays, switches and control and monitoring devices and takes corrective measures in collaboration with Electrical Engineer / Supervisor. 2 To read electrical schematics and logic & control drawings and trouble shoot problems of control circuits and PLCs. 3 To carry out wiring work and connect cables and wires between machines and equipments. Also to replaces faulty wiring and electrical components of machines such as relays, switches, motor bearings and position sensing devices. 4 To apply electrical craft, techniques, processes and principles and be responsible for all necessary preparation required to carry out electrical maintenance to equipments/area assigned to him. 5 To align, adjust and calibrate equipments according to specifications and to maintain records of repairs, calibrations and tests. 6 To report to his Forman for spare parts and consumables in his area to update spares availability to cope up with the maintenance requirements. 7 To confirm all safety and proper isolation is carried out to repair the equipment under maintenance with coordination with his Forman and local operator. 8 To read and understand technical manuals, wiring diagrams and system piping & instrumentation diagrams and apply the knowledge to carry out maintenance and troubleshooting tasks. 9 To carry out any other duty assigned to him by the management from time to time. 10 Follow standard procedures. 11 Use proper PPEs and implement prescribed risk controls. 12 Report deviations in Quality, Health and safety management system. 13 Report emergencies and near misses. 14 Ensure proper waste disposal measures. 15 Perform other duties as assigned. Job Specifications Educational Desired Associate’s Diploma(3 years DAE in Electrical ) Preferred Minimum Experience (Type and duration) Minimum 3 years related experience and training or equivalent combination of education and experience. Preferable 5 years of related experience and training or equivalent combination of education and experience. Required Skills 1. 82a318e96c294fa7.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Project Control Manager to join its team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. 822c6664327bbbe3.description: Salla is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce platforms in the MENA region, empowering merchants with the technology they need to build, manage, and scale their businesses. As we expand our presence in the region, we’re looking for a Branch Accountant to take ownership of the day-to-day finance and accounting operations of our new Dubai branch. You’ll play a key role in establishing strong financial operations from day one. You’ll manage the branch’s accounting activities end to end—from bookkeeping, reconciliations, invoicing, collections, and payments to tax compliance, reporting, and month-end closing—while working closely with Salla’s Controllership team in Saudi Arabia. This role is ideal for a hands-on accountant who is comfortable working independently, building structure in a new environment, and taking full ownership of branch-level financial operations. What You'll Do: Own the end-to-end accounting and financial operations of the Dubai branch , ensuring transactions are complete, accurate, properly supported, and recorded on time. Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, including journal entries, general ledger activities, accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations . Maintain the branch trial balance and general ledger , investigating and resolving discrepancies before each reporting cycle. Lead month-end and year-end closing activities for the Dubai branch in coordination with Salla’s Controllership team. Prepare accurate and timely branch financial reports, schedules, reconciliations, and supporting analysis for management and group reporting. Manage accounts receivable , including invoicing, collections, aging reports, payment follow-ups, and reconciliation of customer and partner balances. Manage accounts payable and branch disbursements , ensuring payments are appropriately documented, approved, recorded, and processed on time. Coordinate payroll-related financial activities with relevant stakeholders and ensure accurate accounting and reconciliation of payroll transactions. Coordinate with banks, auditors, tax advisors, vendors, partners, and other external parties on branch finance matters when required. Maintain the branch fixed asset register , including additions, disposals, transfers, depreciation, and periodic physical verification in accordance with Salla’s capitalization and accounting policies. Support UAE Corporate Tax and transfer pricing compliance , including preparation of related-party/intercompany transaction schedules, supporting documentation, tax reconciliations, and coordination with tax advisors. Own intercompany accounting , including head-office allocations, shared-service charges, employee costs, reimbursements, funding transactions, and monthly reconciliation/confirmation of balances with other Salla entities. Maintain organized and audit-ready financial records , contracts, invoices, approvals, and supporting documentation. Identify gaps in existing processes and proactively build and improve finance procedures, controls, and documentation as the Dubai operation scales. Provide the Saudi-based Controllership team with clear visibility into the branch’s financial position, outstanding items, risks, and upcoming requirements. Serve as the primary finance point of contact for the Dubai General Manager , providing support from Makkah on financial requests, approvals, budget tracking, and operational finance matters. What Will Make You Stand Out: Previous experience helping set up or establish the finance operations of a new branch or legal entity. Experience in technology, e-commerce, SaaS, FinTech, marketplaces, or another high-growth environment. Able to prioritize effectively and operate in a fast-moving, evolving environment where processes are still being established. Professional accounting qualification or progress toward one, such as ACCA, CMA, or equivalent. Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and follow issues through to resolution. Comfortable working independently as the dedicated finance representative for Dubai branch, while collaborating closely with a regional team Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field . 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience , preferably supporting a branch, subsidiary, regional entity, or independently managed finance operation. Practical experience covering general ledger accounting, bookkeeping, journal entries, trial balance preparation, account reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting , supported by specific examples of responsibilities held. Participation in at least 12 monthly closes and one year-end close . Experience supporting at least two group entities , including intercompany reconciliations. Demonstrated experience applying financial controls and supporting audits . At least one year of ERP experience with NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics, Odoo, or equivalent. Practical Excel proficiency in lookups, SUMIFS, PivotTables, and reconciliations . Demonstrated ability to coordinate with senior management and external stakeholders . Professional proficiency in written and spoken English .
